worked_steps.action: Compare the roots with the interval and check signs
worked_steps.reason: Distance adds positive leg lengths; a root outside the interval does not require a direction split.
worked_steps.result: Only $t=3$ lies in $(0,4)$; the simple root changes the velocity sign.

worked_steps.action: Find a primitive of the expanded velocity
worked_steps.reason: Use the same velocity for each travelled leg.

worked_steps.action: Evaluate both bounds on each sign-constant leg
worked_steps.reason: Take the absolute value of each signed leg integral.

criteria.achievement: Solve v=0 with at most one algebra/arithmetic slip and coherently compare roots/signs with the interval, or give a complete valid constant-sign argument. A vertex value alone is insufficient.
Correct cubic primitive.
Using an attempted primitive, evaluate both bounds on every chosen sign-constant leg and combine nonnegative lengths. Limited own-root follow-through after a credible solve/decision.
Canonical total distance in metres, with correct primitive, valid leg construction and without wrong working. A false-root numerical coincidence does not qualify.

accepted_alternatives.requirements: Justify the sign decomposition and evaluate primitive bounds on all legs; same four slots.
When valid, endpoint signs plus appropriate concavity, or a complete root/sign argument, replaces the root-solve route in R1. A vertex value alone is insufficient.

parts.prompt: Find the signed displacement in the first 4 seconds, in metres, showing your working. Give an exact answer or a value correct to 3 significant figures.

worked_steps.reason: Displacement preserves signs rather than adding unsigned distances.
The previously found primitive may be reused.

criteria.achievement: Signed whole-interval integration with an attempted primitive and both bounds, or the signed sum of evaluated primitive legs from distance working.
Canonical signed displacement in metres after the signed integration method.

accepted_alternatives.requirements: Reuse evaluated primitive legs with their signs, not calculator-only unworked values.

private_math.model_exposure_note: Track the polynomial model, but do not impose a new model-no-repeat restriction reducing the approved 168 bounded tasks.

practice_help.title: Plan your working
prompts: Distinguish acceleration, velocity and position.
Write a primitive and use the stated initial or boundary conditions.
For total distance, justify whether velocity changes sign in the given interval.

misread_policy.rule: Judge gross evidence and dependencies first; an eligible question-data misread costs one earned A/B mark once per datum, in question/criterion order, carrying forward if needed. Never deduct from M/DM. Eligible follow-through does not override MR09 supplied-result proof requirements or OD-1 required working.
misread_policy.eligibility: Decide once at first use for the connected question; a changed object/difficulty or own-figure slip remains canonical throughout.
misread_policy.competing_datum_settlement: Unresolved E/F carry: competing eligible data sharing an earned mark require an explicit accepted settlement; do not infer a grade from datum list order.

question.exposure_policy: All assessed-part and shared exposure keys must be unseen for wholly fresh use, across output-affecting revisions. Version is provenance and never resets exposure. Disclosed repeated-component practice is separate; do not silently switch branches on exhaustion.
